name: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited
about: Zodiac Clothing Company Limited manufactures, retails, and trades men's clothing and accessories in India and internationally. The company provides shirts, ties, trousers, innerwear, polos, and jackets, as well as accessories, including cufflinks, pocket squares, belts, socks, and handkerchiefs. It offers its products under the Zodiac, Zod, and Z3 brands. It operates a chain of retail stores. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Mumbai, India.
